Cadastral map of town of Madrid, Maine, showing numbered lots; acreage and dimensions given for some lots.

Cadastral map of town of Madrid, Maine, showing numbered lots; acreage and dimensions given for some lots. "This plan represents township number one in the first range of townships west of the Million Acres ... supposed to lay in the county of Oxford." Title from verso. Pen-and-ink. Mounted on cloth backing. Note added to map after it was drawn: Oxford ss. recd. August 1, 1820 and recorded with the records of deeds for said county, book 30, page 32, att. Hanson Mellen, register. Copy imperfect: Soiled, torn, small sections missing along edges of sheet. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault Acquisitions control no. 83-56
